name: Female chant hook
desc: Female TTS words pitched by a rising speed contour into a bright pop hook, with an octave off-echo halo, opposite-phase filter/pan sweeps and every-4 double-time lifts. A pitched diphone counter-chant keeps the hook audible even while the TTS pack warms. Dreamy, catchy, uplifting. Groove survives if the TTS layer drops out.

code.full: stack(s("moonlight forever higher tonight").speed("<1 1.2 1.5 1.33>").shape(.35).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/8, x=>x.speed(2).gain(.25)), n("0 3 7 3").s("diphone").speed("<1 1.2>").shape(.3).lpf(${cut}).gain(${gain}*.65)).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).room(.4).delay(${send}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.4).orbit(8).play()
